label: Reconstructed Mexican and Latin American feminist philosophy from Castellanos onward
description: In Las ideas feministas latinoamericanas, Gargallo traced Castellanos as a foundational node in Latin America’s autonomous feminist philosophical tradition.
dialecticalTension: Transforms fragmented essays into a recognized continental philosophical historiography.

label: Co-theorized and documented Abya Yala Indigenous and community feminisms
description: In Feminismos desde Abya Yala, Gargallo engaged Julieta Paredes’s Aymara community feminism to articulate non-Eurocentric feminist epistemologies.
dialecticalTension: Bridges urban Mexican feminist philosophy with Aymara and Mayan community feminisms.
